learning_objective: 🎯 Zoom deep into the nucleus! Master the Central Dogma of molecular biology: how the DNA double helix replicates, transcribes its message into RNA, and translates it into the proteins that build you.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: DNA is a double-stranded helix. The backbone is made of sugar and phosphate. The 'rungs' of the ladder are nitrogenous bases paired strictly: Adenine (A) always pairs with Thymine (T), and Guanine (G) always pairs with Cytosine (C).

It is 'Semi-conservative'. The double helix unzips, and an enzyme called DNA Polymerase reads each old strand to build a brand new complementary strand. Every new DNA molecule has one old strand and one new strand.

The process of copying a gene from DNA into a messenger RNA (mRNA) molecule. Because DNA is too precious to leave the nucleus, the mRNA acts as a disposable copy that carries the instructions out to the cell.

The ribosome reads the mRNA in sets of three letters called 'Codons'. Each codon specifies one exact amino acid. Transfer RNA (tRNA) brings the correct amino acids, linking them together to build a protein chain.

Cells don't need all proteins all the time. The Lac Operon in bacteria is a set of genes that can be turned 'on' or 'off' like a switch. It only turns 'on' to digest lactose when lactose is actually present in the environment!

fun_activity.title: 🍓 DIY Strawberry DNA Extraction
fun_activity.instructions: Mash a strawberry in a ziplock bag with a splash of water, a pinch of salt, and a drop of dish soap (this breaks the cell walls). Filter the liquid into a glass. Carefully pour ice-cold rubbing alcohol on top. You will see stringy, cloudy white strands rise to the top—that's pure strawberry DNA!

exam_tips: 📌 The Hershey-Chase experiment (using radioactive Sulfur and Phosphorus on bacteriophages) is the ultimate proof that DNA is the genetic material. Be ready to explain it.
📌 Remember the direction! DNA replication and transcription ONLY occur in the 5' to 3' direction.
📌 Practice drawing the diagram of the Lac Operon showing both scenarios: in the absence of an inducer (repressed) and in the presence of an inducer (active).
quick_recap: ⭐ The Central Dogma of biology states that genetic information flows only one way: DNA -> RNA -> Protein.
⭐ The genetic code is 'universal'—the codon AUG codes for the amino acid Methionine in bacteria, plants, and humans alike!
⭐ Human DNA Project revealed that 99.9% of the DNA sequence is exactly the same in every single human on Earth.
